stories.title: Boucher thrilled to score winner in NHL debut
stories.summary: Tyler Boucher tried not to smile after he scored his first NHL goal on Tuesday.

stories.title: Boucher nets winner as Senators sink Jets 2-1
stories.summary: Tyler Boucher scored the game-winner in his NHL debut to lift the Ottawa Senators to a 2-1 victory over the Winnipeg Jets on Tuesday.

stories.title: 6-game win streak snapped as Winnipeg Jets fall 2-1 at home to Ottawa
stories.summary: Viggo Björck's first NHL goal was the lone marker for the Jets as they were unable to dig themselves out of a 2-0 deficit.

stories.title: 7 bird flu cases across Prairies linked to Saskatchewan poultry show
stories.summary: Seven cases of highly pathogenic avian influenza have been detected in the Prairie provinces after an exposure at a Saskatchewan poultry show earlier this month.

stories.title: Church bell found in ditch after being reported stolen: Manitoba RCMP
stories.summary: Manitoba RCMP say it has located the missing church bell that belongs to Sacred Heart of Jesus church in the Interlake.

stories.title: ER openings, free shingles shots and AI rules in Manitoba throne speech
stories.summary: Premier Wab Kinew, at his NDP's annual convention on the weekend, talked about next year's general election and a focus on health care and affordability.

stories.title: Winnipeg Jets’ Mark Scheifele named 1st star of the week after record-breaking performance
stories.summary: Mark Scheifele was named a player of the week for the 10th time in his career after breaking Jets franchise records.

stories.title: Dale Hawerchuk’s son reflects on ‘surreal’ Scheifele record for Winnipeg Jets
stories.summary: "Sometimes life is stranger than fiction," says the son of Jets legend Dale Hawerchuk, as he reflected on Mark Scheifele becoming the franchise's all-time leading scorer.

stories.title: 300-pound church bell stolen in Manitoba’s Interlake region: RCMP
stories.summary: Police are investigating after a church bell was stolen in the RM of Armstrong. The Manitoba RCMP said it is unclear how or when the alleged theft occurred.

stories.title: 4 people charged with manslaughter after death of 33-year-old in Winnipeg
stories.summary: Three men and one female teenager are facing manslaughter charges in relation to the death of Kyle Andrew Devon Jerome in Winnipeg.
